statement: Start a national conversation about governing without political parties ('Exit politics')

summary.why: NAP says parties force voters into 'package deals' and the system is 'better at producing political careers than producing good decisions'.
summary.how: Experiment with citizens' assemblies, deliberative democracy, local decision-making, participatory budgeting, digital consultation and rotating civic representation, with New Zealand as 'a laboratory for innovation in governance'.

sources.title: Not A Party has a radical proposal — leave politics behind (media release, 7 Oct 2026)

statement: Move peacefully to a society based on voluntary cooperation, guided by principles of self-sovereignty and self-government

summary.how: Its listed principles: self-sovereignty, self-government, self-ownership, self-reliance, self-defence, self-control, self-respect, self-help, solidarity and 'safer communities together'.
